title: docs(skills): objectstack-data names actionLayout among the pair-only keys; objectstack-automation says an option label in a flow filter or edge condition is refused
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu3zQ2AqeghSGpv6Q7VEPDyQ)_

Fixes #37057

Part of #37504 (item 1 only; its item 2, the `os explain` text, remains on that card)

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

Fold note: one PR for two shipped skill sentences that lag a landed rule, card 37057 item 2 (objectstack-data) and card 37504 item 1 (objectstack-automation).

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:用户无感;装了数据建模和流程自动化技能包的 AI 助手读到的两句说明改对了:一句补上「按钮顺序」也只能由配对的定制包来写,一句不再说流程过滤条件里写选项显示名「不会被检查」。
- 为什么做:属于「已发布技能说明跟上已落地规则」的收尾;原来两句话都比平台实际的校验说得少,助手照着写会被校验拦下却不知道原因。
- 出错会怎样:只改了说明文字,写错了最多是助手读到不准确的说明;撤回这一个改动即可恢复。
- 要你做什么:无。

## What changes

### 1. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, "Object Extension Model" (card 37057 item 2)

Before:

> Only the pair's extension may also write `fieldGroups` and `relatedLists`, shaped as on an object. [...] Outside a `.custom` package both keys are refused at those doors: use `place`.

After:

> Only the pair's extension also writes `fieldGroups`, `relatedLists` and `actionLayout` (**objectstack-ui**), shaped as on an object. A written key replaces that arrangement whole (the owner's and every `place`; `actionLayout`, each arm it writes): [...] Outside a `.custom` package they are refused at those doors: use `place`, or for an action its own `locations` and `order`.

Source, read at `1af67b26cd`: `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS` in `packages/spec/src/data/field-customization.ts` is `['fieldGroups', 'relatedLists', 'actionLayout']`, and its docblock names the one judge that refuses the three outside `.custom` at publish, `os validate` / `os build` and install. The two qualifiers are that docblock's and the judge's own: "`actionLayout` replaces the owner's arm for each scope it writes (`list`, `record`), and an arm it does not write stays", and the `actionLayout` entry of `PRESCRIPTION` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-extension-arrangement.ts`, "place an action this package brings by the action's own `locations` and `order`" (contract review S1, record 7193228650, answered at `5040c6d6e4`). The pointer to objectstack-ui is there because objectstack-data teaches no `actionLayout` shape; `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` does, and already points back at this sentence.

Paid for in the same file, no ceiling raised and `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` not edited:

- "may also write" is now "also writes", "both keys" is now "they", and the second "still shows" in "an unnamed tab still shows after the listed ones" is dropped (the clause before it carries the verb);
- the Quick Reference line for Index Strategy loses ", partial indexes": the Index Patterns pointer to the same rules file already names "partial / gin / gist indexes at the database layer";
- the Quick Reference lines for Naming Conventions and Field Types keep their links and lose their glosses ("snake_case rules, option values, config properties", "All field types and configs"): "Naming Rules Summary" and "Field Type Selection" under Common Patterns say the same and link the same two files.

### 2. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, trap 4 (card 37504 item 1)

Before:

> A start `condition: "record.status == 'Lost'"` or `fields: { status: 'Lost' }` is refused at publish (inline options), else matches no row or fails the run (`invalid_option`). A label in a `filter` or an edge `condition` is never checked: it silently matches nothing.

After:

> A start or edge `condition: "record.status == 'Lost'"`, or `filter` / `fields: { status: 'Lost' }`, is refused at publish (inline options), else matches no row or fails the run (`invalid_option`); a filter for rows still holding the label takes a CEL envelope operand.

Source, read at `1af67b26cd` (which carries PR 37491): the `FLOW_CONDITION_OPTION_LABEL` docblock in `packages/lint/src/validate-flow-trigger-readiness.ts` says the one id now also reads "an edge condition and a `decision` branch [...] and a query filter's operand (`get_record` / `update_record` / `delete_record` `filter`, a time-relative sweep's `filter`)", at `error` at every position. The rule entry in `packages/lint/src/authoring-rules.ts` is `tier: 'gating'` on the CLI and the runtime publish gate. The escape hatch is the rule's own text: "A filter that means to find rows still holding a label (a clean-up after an options change) spells the operand as a CEL value envelope, which is not judged"; `optionLabelOperands` in `packages/lint/src/flow-select-options.ts` skips every operand that is not a plain string.

The clause keeps the docblock's "rows still holding" sense, so it does not read as the way to filter by a display label (contract review N1). The new text is one byte longer than the text it replaces and fits the existing ceiling, so nothing else in that file moves.

Changeset: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

## Tests

No code changed, so no test changed and nothing was ablated. Skill evals: NOT MEASURED, reason: no model runner in this container.

Local gates at head `5040c6d6e4` (the whole derived list was run again after the review round), each exit code captured before any pipe:

- `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 50 families; 49 exit 0, among them `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` (the two readings above), `check:skill-docs` ("Skill docs in sync"), `check:skill-served-sections`, `check:skill-links`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:published-files`, `check-empty-changeset`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check:pm-governed-merges`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, reason: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET (it reads every package's `dist`; only the lint and client-react closures were built for a prose diff). `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` exit 0 over the packages built, a partial sweep. CI runs all four on a full build.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "50 derived, 50 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN" (its record carries no exit codes; the one above is the real not-measured count).
- Outside the derived list: spec `check:skill-examples` exit 0 ("352 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)"), spec `check:skill-refs` exit 0.
- `overlap-check` at `3f3ea1c913`: "VERDICT overlap exit 1", naming PR 36158 alone (both files; expected and accepted in the claim on card 37057); with `--exclude-pr=36158`, at `5040c6d6e4` against `origin/main` `061e342242`: "VERDICT clean exit 0".

Eval grep, for every phrase the diff removes:

- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/**`: "never checked", "silently matches", "A label in": 0 hits.
- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/**`: "may also write", "partial index", "snake_case rules", "All field types": 0 hits. "both keys" and "still shows": 1 hit each, both in the `expected_output` of case 27 of `objects-fields-relationships.json` ("both keys are refused there [...] and the refusal prescribes `place`", "a tab it does not name still shows after the listed ones"). The skill still teaches both ("they are refused at those doors: use `place`", "an unnamed tab after the listed ones"); neither phrase is a `must_contain` token.

## Acceptance notes

- The automation sentence keeps the existing "(inline options), else matches no row" frame for the new positions. The rule is narrower than that frame in one corner: an edge condition is judged only on the trigger record or on a variable bound by one single-row `get_record` alone; a variable bound by anything else is not judged and falls under "else matches no row".
- The skill names the edge `condition` and not the `decision` node's `conditions[].expression`, because its node table teaches branching "by edge `condition` predicates, not node config".

## Verification

Read first:

1. `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md`, the hunk at line 325: the risk is the sentence claiming more than `flow-condition-option-label` refuses, or naming the envelope where it is judged (a start condition written as an envelope is still read; only a filter operand envelope is not).
2. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, the hunk at line 385: the risk is the three-key sentence against `CUSTOM_ARRANGEMENT_KEYS`, and whether the two `actionLayout` qualifiers say what the spec docblock and the judge's prescription say.
3. `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md`, lines 34 to 38: the three paying cuts.

Two-minute check: `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`, and expect `objectstack-data/SKILL.md` at 6709 tokens against ceiling 6710 and `objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` at 7045 against 7045, exit 0.

L2: contract review record 7193228650 (head `3f3ea1c913`) left S1 open; `5040c6d6e4` answers it and owes a delta review that settles S1 by id before this lands. The seat lands it (governed surface, draft until then).
